name: gizza-ai/csv-dedupe
summary: Remove duplicate rows from a CSV.

tool.description: Remove duplicate rows from CSV, keeping the first occurrence. By default a row is a duplicate when the whole row matches; set `columns` (1-based indices or header names) to key the dedup on a subset of columns. `header`=true keeps the first row and lets you name columns. `delimiter` is a char or comma/tab/semicolon/pipe.

columns.description: Optional comma-separated key columns (1-based indices, or header names when header=true). Empty = match the whole row.

header.description: Treat the first row as a header (kept, and matchable by name). Default true.

delimiter.description: Field separator: a single char or 'comma'/'tab'/'semicolon'/'pipe'. Default ','.
